extension.description: Fixes VS Code's workspace search encoding limitation. Automatically searches EUC-JP, Shift_JIS, and UTF-8 files simultaneously without changing your settings.
views.multiEncodingSearch.name: Multi-Encoding Search
config.title: Multi-Encoding Search
config.encodings.description: List of character encodings to search simultaneously in parallel. Supports UTF-8, EUC-JP, Shift_JIS, UTF-16LE/BE, Windows-1252, GB18030, GBK, Big5, EUC-KR.
config.rgPath.description: ripgrep executable name or full path (bundled by default)
config.results.showLineNumbers.descripti: Whether to display line numbers in search results (default: false).
config.results.fontSize.description: Font size (in pixels) for search results in the sidebar. Set to 0 to use VS Code default.
config.results.fontFamily.description: Font family for search results (e.g. 'Cascadia Code', 'Consolas', monospace). Leave empty to use VS Code default.
Background color for matched search keywords (e.g. '#ea5c0055' or 'rgba(234, 92, 0, 0.33)'). Leave empty for theme default.
Text color for matched search keywords. Leave empty for theme default.
config.results.textColor.description: Text color for search result line previews. Leave empty for theme default.
config.results.secondaryTextColor.descri: Text color for line numbers and directory paths. Leave empty for theme default.
